stories.title: France extends Black Sea maritime patrol after cargo ship attacks
stories.summary: France is extending the deployment of its maritime patrol plane in the Black Sea in response to recent attacks on cargo ships, a sign of rising security concerns along a key shipping route.

stories.title: Bangladesh garment protests continue despite wage board move
stories.summary: Garment workers in Bangladesh are pressing on with protests despite a wage board decision, keeping pressure on the country's crucial ready-made-garment export sector.

stories.title: Two dead after under-construction building collapses in Delhi's Chawri Bazar
stories.summary: Two people died when an under-construction building collapsed in Delhi's Chawri Bazar area, renewing concerns about construction safety in the Indian capital.

stories.title: Paraguay Congress opens session to debate President Peña's impeachment
stories.summary: Paraguay's Congress began a session to debate the impeachment of President Santiago Peña, setting up a potential political crisis in the South American nation.

stories.title: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber for finding and fixing security vulnerabilities
stories.summary: GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5% on the ExploitGym exploit benchmark and helped uncover dozens of previously unknown high-severity flaws in Firefox, aimed at defending software while staying within scope.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video generation
stories.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash supports native 15-second video clips and multi-turn conversational editing, with prices cut 30% to $0.07 per second for 720p video.

stories.title: Alpine Linux warns of password authentication bypass in openssh-server
stories.summary: Alpine Linux disclosed that an attacker who can reach an exposed SSH port can log in without a password on affected systems; users are urged to update openssh or disable password authentication.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol; Browns' Week 9 report lists no full participants
stories.summary: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson is in concussion protocol after taking a hit to the head in Week 8, and no player was a full practice participant Wednesday ahead of Sunday's game at New Orleans.

stories.title: Ryan Day: Julian Sayin out 'not next week or next month'
stories.summary: Ohio State QB Julian Sayin will miss at least another month with an elbow injury, coach Ryan Day said, leaving freshman Luke Fahey as the starter with the Buckeyes' playoff hopes on the line.

stories.title: Ohio State injury report: Jay Timmons cleared; Oregon's Jordon Davison out
stories.summary: Ohio State safety Jay Timmons has been cleared to play against Oregon, while the Ducks will be without leading rusher Jordon Davison, adding to a long list of absences for Saturday's game.

stories.title: F2 leader Rafael Camara to make F1 debut for Haas in São Paulo as Ocon exits
stories.summary: Haas confirmed Esteban Ocon will not return this season and that Ferrari junior Rafael Camara, the F2 points leader, will make his F1 debut alongside Ollie Bearman at the São Paulo Grand Prix.

stories.title: Columbus man fights parole for sister's killer, pushes for Ohio law change
stories.summary: A Columbus man is fighting the potential release of the person convicted of killing his sister, arguing a 2021 law made the killer parole-eligible decades earlier than originally scheduled.

stories.title: Three Ohio counties to watch as voters decide Senate, governor races
stories.summary: Ohio's closely contested U.S. Senate and governor races hinge on three counties where Democrats hope to rebuild in former strongholds while Republicans push to expand suburban gains.
